item.title: Responsible and Open Science in Action
item.content:encoded:
This is a coordinated four-part virtual special issue portfolio for the Pacific-Basin Finance Journal.

Timeline

  • December 31, 2028: Full paper submission deadline
item.author: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal (ELSEVIER)

item.title: AI Disruption in Global Capital Markets
item.content:encoded:
Potential topics

  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning applications in financial markets
  • Algorithmic trading and high-frequency trading
  • AI-driven market microstructure and price discovery
  • Systemic risk and financial stability implications of AI
  • Regulatory frameworks and governance of AI in finance
  • Market efficiency and anomalies in AI-dominated markets
  • Risk management and portfolio optimization with AI
  • Ethical considerations and fairness in AI-driven finance
  • Impact on market participants and trading strategies
  • Data quality, bias, and robustness of AI models in finance

Timeline

  • April 30, 2027: Full paper submission deadline
item.author: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal (ELSEVIER)

item.title: Information, Institutions, and Financial Markets, an Emerging Market Perspective
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the intersection of information availability, institutional quality, and financial market dynamics in emerging economies. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how information flows, institutional frameworks, and market structures interact to shape financial outcomes in developing and transition economies.

Potential topics

  • Role of information asymmetry in emerging market financial markets
  • Institutional quality and financial market efficiency
  • Corporate governance in emerging markets
  • Information disclosure and transparency requirements
  • Market microstructure in emerging economies
  • Regulatory frameworks and their impact on financial markets
  • Behavioral finance in emerging markets
  • Information technology and financial market development

Timeline

  • August 15, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Forensic Finance: Litigation, Misconduct, and Enforcement
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on forensic finance research related to litigation, misconduct, and enforcement. The issue welcomes empirical and theoretical research that examines financial fraud, corporate misconduct, regulatory enforcement actions, and related legal proceedings.

Timeline

  • October 31, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Family Business, Entrepreneurship and Corporate Governance
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on family business, entrepreneurship and corporate governance in the Pacific-Basin region. The issue invites research that examines the unique characteristics, challenges, and opportunities of family enterprises and their governance structures in this dynamic economic area.

Timeline

  • December 31, 2025: Full paper submission deadline
